title: Create a complete, modern, responsive single-page static e-commerce we
prompt:
Create a complete, modern, responsive single-page static e-commerce website for "NEXUS — Premium Wireless Audio & Smart Gear" with an ultra-sleek dark tech aesthetic and 100% working interactive JavaScript for every button.

REQUIREMENTS & FILE STRUCTURE:
- Deliver a clean, self-contained "index.html" with linked "styles.css" and full vanilla JavaScript.
- Do NOT use React, build tools, or placeholder links like "href='#'" or "TODO".

VISUAL & MEDIA REQUIREMENTS:
- Include relevant, high-quality images with descriptive alt text for:
  - Hero banner showcasing premium wireless headphones with ambient neon lighting
  - 6 distinct product cards (Over-ear ANC Headphones, True Wireless Earbuds, Studio Microphone, Bluetooth Speaker, Smartwatch, and Slim Mechanical Keyboard)
  - Customer review avatar photos
- All images must include rich, detailed alt descriptions and smooth hover zoom effects.

EVERY BUTTON MUST HAVE REAL WORKING JAVASCRIPT LOGIC:

1. Navigation Bar:
   - Brand Logo: "NEXUS" with a glowing tech badge.
   - Live Search Input: Typing filters the product grid in real time by title, category, and specs.
   - Wishlist Icon: Displays a live counter badge of saved items.
   - Cart Icon Button: Displays a dynamic item counter badge; clicking slides open the Cart Drawer.

2. Hero Section:
   - Headline: "Pure Sound. Zero Noise."
   - Subtitle: "Precision-engineered audiophile grade wireless sound designed for those who refuse compromise."
   - "Shop Best Sellers" button: Smoothly scrolls down to the product catalog.
   - "Watch Feature Demo" button: Opens an interactive tech showcase modal.

3. Interactive Category Filter Tabs:
   - Filter buttons: "All Products", "Headphones", "Earbuds", "Speakers", "Wearables".
   - Clicking immediately filters the displayed product cards with smooth transitions and updates the active tab styling.

4. Product Grid (6 unique tech products):
   - Each product card must display:
     - Badge ("Best Seller", "New Arrival", or "Sale -20%").
     - Product image with hover scaling.
     - Star rating (e.g., ★★★★★ 4.9) and review count.
     - Product title, key spec tags (e.g., "40h Battery • ANC"), and price.
     - Wishlist Heart Button: Toggles heart color (red/white) and updates the navbar wishlist counter badge.
     - Quick View Button: Opens a modal showing product photos, detailed technical specs, color options, and quantity selector.
     - "Add to Cart" Button: Adds the item to the cart, increments the navbar badge counter, and triggers a floating Toast Notification.

5. Functional Slide-Over Cart Drawer:
   - Slides smoothly from the right when the cart icon is clicked.
   - Renders cart items with thumbnail, title, price, quantity controls (+ / - buttons), and a trash/delete button.
   - Dynamic price calculation: Subtotal, Free Shipping ($0.00), Estimated Tax (8%), and Grand Total.
   - "Proceed to Checkout" button: Opens the Checkout Modal.
   - Close Drawer button (X) and backdrop click dismissal.

6. Interactive Checkout Modal:
   - Form fields: Full Name, Email, Shipping Address, and Payment Method toggle (Credit Card / Apple Pay / Cash on Delivery).
   - "Complete Purchase" button: Validates required inputs, shows a brief 1-second loading state, clears the cart, and displays an "Order Confirmed! Order #NEX-7821" celebration view with a receipt summary.

7. Customer Testimonials & Newsletter:
   - Testimonial cards featuring customer avatar photos and verified buyer badges.
   - Newsletter signup with email validation: Clicking "Subscribe" shows an instant confirmation message ("Welcome to NEXUS Insider VIP").

8. Floating Toast Notification System:
   - Pops up in the bottom-right corner with feedback on user actions:
     - "Item added to cart!"
     - "Wishlist updated!"
     - "Order placed successfully!"

DESIGN & PALETTE:
- Premium Cyberpunk / Modern Dark Mode:
  - Deep carbon background (#0b0f19, #111827).
  - Electric blue and violet neon accents (#38bdf8, #818cf8).
  - Glassmorphic frosted cards (backdrop-filter: blur(12px), subtle border rgba(255,255,255,0.08)).
  - Clean Inter/system-ui typography with polished micro-interactions.
